properties.description:
This project consists of installing a new grid-interactive photovoltaic and energy-storage system at 5717 Louise Ln Austin TX in accordance with the attached planset and the 2023 NEC. Work includes electrical installation of a new 9.680 kW DC / 16.0 kW AC PV system consisting of (22) Phono Draco PS440M8GF-18/VNH modules each equipped with Tigo TS4-A-O optimizers interconnected to a new EG4 FlexBOSS 21 hybrid inverter. Two EG4 14.3 kWh PowerPro batteries and associated EG4 Battery Conduit Boxes will be installed to provide whole-home backup via the EG4 GridBoss gateway. All battery equipment is UL 9540 certified as shown in the planset.

Work includes routing new DC homeruns to a roof-mounted junction box installing an IMO 4-pole DC disconnect installing AC conductors between the inverter GridBoss and the existing 200A main service panel and landing the system on a dedicated backfeed breaker sized per inverter specifications. All grounding and bonding will follow NEC 250 and 690 requirements. Rapid shutdown functionality per NEC 690.12 will be provided through module-level electronics.

The existing PV systemcomprised of (30) Canadian Solar CS6K-280M modules with P300 optimizers a SolarEdge SE7600 inverter PV meter and existing AC disconnectwill remain in place. No service upgrade main breaker derate structural modifications or roofing penetrations beyond those shown on the plans are included. All work will follow manufacturer installation requirements maintain NEC-required clearances and be inspected prior to energization.

properties.description:
Install one (1) EG4 FlexBOSS 21 Hybrid Inverter (240 V 16 kW AC output) and three (3) EG4 PowerPro All-Weather Lithium Batteries (51.2 VDC 280 Ah each;  14.3 kWh per unit 42.9 kWh total) at the existing residence.  Equipment will be wall-mounted on the northeast exterior garage wall adjacent to existing PV inverters and service equipment.  The system will integrate with two existing SolarEdge inverters (SE-10000H & SE-7600H) serving a 17.6 kWdc / 17.6 kWac rooftop PV array.

The new hybrid inverter and battery system will be interconnected through an EG4 GridBoss micro-grid interconnection device providing backup load capability and grid-interactive operation.  AC output from the FlexBOSS 21 will connect to the GridBoss and then to the existing 200 A main service panel (240 V 1-phase 3-wire underground service).  New conductors will be copper THWN-2 in EMT conduit sized per NEC 690.8 240 and 310.15 for a maximum 66.7 A inverter output.  OCPDs and disconnects will be provided per NEC 705.12 and 706.15.  A visible lockable labeled AC disconnect will be installed within 5 feet of the utility meter (Austin Energy #7163517).

All components will be UL listed and installed per manufacturers specifications 2023 NEC 2021 IRC/IBC/IFC and City of Austin Electrical Code.  System includes rapid-shutdown functionality proper signage and labeling per NEC 690 and 705.  No structural modifications are required.  Work includes conduit routing grounding electrode bonding labeling commissioning and verification of interconnection with Austin Energy prior to energization.
